name: Wedding Catering
description: Elegant multi-course menus, live counters, and premium service for your special day.
pricingNote: Typically ₹400–₹1,200 per plate depending on menu and guest count.
details: Includes welcome drinks, starters, main course, desserts, and service staff.

name: Corporate Events
description: Professional catering for conferences, office parties, and business gatherings.
pricingNote: Packages from ₹250–₹800 per person for breakfast, lunch, or high-tea.
